description: Land Acquisition - Kelaniwatta, Ambagamuwa D/S Division, Nuwaraeliya District and an amendment of Hingurakgoda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land lots being acquired for the extension of the Hingurakgoda Air Force Camp, including boundaries, extents, and claimant information. The content focuses solely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other administrative matters that would fall under other categories.
